events.text: The Celts have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God-King ([ICON_BUILDING_PALACE] Palace provides +1 to these yields: [ICON_CULTURE], [ICON_PEACE], [ICON_GOLD], [ICON_PRODUCTION], [ICON_FOOD], [ICON_RESEARCH], [ICON_HAPPINESS_1])

Spain has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Sea (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from Fishing Boats and Atolls, a free Work Boat appears near the [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital)

The Maya have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Sun God (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for each [ICON_RES_WHEAT] Wheat, Banana, [ICON_RES_CITRUS] Citrus, [ICON_RES_COCOA] Cocoa, and [ICON_RES_PINEAPPLE] Pineapple resource)

Polynesia has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Voice of the Surf (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from Atolls, and from [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crab, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, Red Caviar, and Caviar resources)

Indonesia has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Seafood Rituals (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from each source of [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crabs, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CAVIAR] Black Caviar and [ICON_RES_REDCAVIAR] Red Caviar. +2 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from each source of [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish)
Anoriel22 has proven that the world is round!

[COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Holy Sites[ENDCOLOR] provide +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Mosques[ENDCOLOR] Allows you to build Mosques with [ICON_PEACE] Faith (+6 [ICON_PEACE] Faith, +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness)[NEWLINE][ICON_PEACE] Faith cost on Quick speed: Mosque 100.
